headline: This weekend, go.
sub: Take the kids. Take a cake. Turn it green.
content:
It's Friday. Somewhere, a gran has already worked out that the weekend is the most likely time for a car in the driveway.

Don't overthink it. A cup of tea, forty minutes, the kids on the carpet. That's the whole thing.

Whoever goes, log it — and the whole family breathes out. 💚
notes: Weekend nudge; no link, pure brand warmth.
